fields.System.Title: Export progress report
fields.System.Description: A signed-in user can export a progress report.
fields.Microsoft.VSTS.Common.AcceptanceCriteria:
Given a report is ready, when the user exports it, then a CSV file downloads.

Given export fails, when the operation ends, then a retry-safe error is shown.
